The map title for '''Gmdm1''' is '''"Exercise One"'''. It's a map with a very steep verticality, and an aesthetic setting of a slimy sewer. It is one of the very few maps that includes a Biosuit, an item that allow you to swim through the poisonous slime where the [[Ring of Shadows]] is placed.
